sections.Profile:
"Preview" is a two-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in August 1962. Designed by Wayne Neyens with artwork by Roy Parker, the game features two flippers, three pop bumpers, two slingshots, and five standup targets.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1962
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 2
- Tags: Two player, Pageantry, Women, Arts & Entertainment, Original Theme, Single level playfield
